shorts_extract.hook: Three balls, 90 days, and three MRI scans: how Draganski (2004 Nature) filmed 'Use It or Lose It' brain growth live.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: 24 beginners scanned Before Juggling (T1), After 90-Day 60s Cascade Mastery (T2: +4% hMT+/V5), and After 90 Idle Days (T3 recession) + Boyke 2008 seniors.
shorts_extract.twist: Why visual-motion radar grew instead of finger cortex, why 60-year-olds grew hippocampal volume too, and keeping Scan-2 branches alive.
